description: FREE, runs locally against Base Mainnet RPC. Dry-run a transaction before sending it: eth_call + eth_estimateGas at the latest block. Predicts whether it will revert and decodes the reason (Error(string), Panic(uint256) codes, custom-error selector, or node rejection such as insufficient funds). Returns { ok, willRevert, revertReason, estimatedGas, returnData }. No transaction is sent and nothing is paid.

data.description: Calldata as 0x-hex (default 0x for a plain ETH transfer).

from.description: Optional sender address; needed for balance/allowance-dependent calls.

to.description: Target contract or recipient address on Base (0x...).

value.description: ETH value in wei, decimal or 0x-hex (default 0).

name: simulate_base_transaction
